question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Concise
solution:
The correct answer is: Brief.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"concise"** means expressing much in few words; clear and succinct. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **The report was **concise **and to the point, covering all the important aspects.
 
 
 
• **"Brief"** refers to something that is short in duration, extent, or length. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was **brief **but very productive.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'concise' **is **'brief'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grief** (शोक): Deep sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

 
 
• **Example:** She was overcome with **grief **after the loss of her pet.
 
 
 
• **Relief** (राहत): A feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.
 
 
• **Example: **After the exams were over, there was a sense of **relief **among the students.
 
 
 
• **Belief** (विश्वास): An acceptance that something exists or is true, especially one without proof.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **belief **in hard work and perseverance led her to success.
